sections.overview:
### Overview
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/components/concepts/overview

Chakra UI v3 is a React component library styled with a **style-props + token-based theming** engine. Styling is authored inline via style props (e.g. `<Box bg="bg" p="4" rounded="md">`), resolved against a token system, and compiled to CSS variables.

### System model
- **Style props** — every visual property is a prop mapped to a token category (`colors`, `space`, `fonts`, `radii`, `shadows`, etc.). Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-styling.txt
- **Tokens + semantic tokens** — raw tokens hold literal values; semantic tokens map to conditions (e.g. `_light` / `_dark`) so they adapt to color mode. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/semantic-tokens
- **Recipes / slot recipes** — variant systems (`base`, `variants`, `compoundVariants`, `defaultVariants`) that encode component variants, sizes, and states; slot recipes style multi-part components. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/recipes
- **Ark UI behavior** — interactive components are built on Ark UI headless state machines. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/components/concepts/overview
- **Color mode** — light/dark via `next-themes`; `_dark` conditional styling. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-components.txt

### Distribution
- Package: `@chakra-ui/react`; charts split into `@chakra-ui/charts`.
- The system is configured with `createSystem(defaultConfig, defineConfig({...}))`.

### Known gaps
- No numeric brand/scale governance is prescribed by the docs; teams define their own token overrides.
sections.colors:
### Colors
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-theming.txt

Chakra ships full color palettes (steps `50`–`950`) plus semantic tokens that adapt to color mode. Palettes shipped out of the box: **gray, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, cyan, purple, pink** (plus `black`, `white`). New colors should provide `50`–`950` values.

### Palette scale — gray (real values)
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `gray.50` | `#fafafa` |
| `gray.100` | `#f4f4f5` |
| `gray.200` | `#e4e4e7` |
| `gray.300` | `#d4d4d8` |
| `gray.400` | `#a1a1aa` |
| `gray.500` | `#71717a` |
| `gray.600` | `#52525b` |
| `gray.700` | `#3f3f46` |
| `gray.800` | `#27272a` |
| `gray.900` | `#18181b` |
| `gray.950` | `#111111` |

### Base hues (step 50)
| Palette | `50` value |
| --- | --- |
| red | `#fef2f2` |
| orange | `#fff7ed` |
| yellow | `#fefce8` |
| green | `#f0fdf4` |
| teal | `#f0fdfa` |
| blue | `#eff6ff` |
| cyan | `#ecfeff` |
| purple | `#faf5ff` |
| pink | `#fdf2f8` |

### Semantic color tokens
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/semantic-tokens

Recommended over raw tokens because they auto-adapt to color mode.
- **Background**: `bg`, `bg.subtle`, `bg.muted`, `bg.emphasized`, `bg.inverted`, `bg.panel`, `bg.error`, `bg.warning`, `bg.success`, `bg.info`
- **Text**: `fg`, `fg.muted`, `fg.subtle`, `fg.inverted`, `fg.error`, `fg.warning`, `fg.success`, `fg.info`
- **Border**: `border`, `border.muted`, `border.subtle`, `border.emphasized`, `border.inverted`, `border.error`, `border.warning`, `border.success`, `border.info`

### Virtual colors (`colorPalette`)
The `colorPalette` prop creates a themeable placeholder; `colorPalette.100` resolves to the active palette's `100` step. Palette semantic aliases include `colorPalette.solid`, `colorPalette.contrast`, `colorPalette.fg`, and the `bg`/`fg`/`border` families above. Example: `<Button colorPalette="blue">`.

### Known gaps
- Full numeric values for palettes other than `gray` are published in the docs' color table but only step `50` values are excerpted here.
sections.typography:
### Typography
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-styling.txt

Typography is token-driven through style props, each mapped to a token category.

### Type style props → token category
| Prop | CSS property | Token category |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontFamily` | `font-family` | `fonts` |
| `fontSize` | `font-size` | `fontSizes` |
| `fontWeight` | `font-weight` | `fontWeights` |
| `lineHeight` | `line-height` | `lineHeights` |
| `letterSpacing` | `letter-spacing` | `letterSpacings` |
| `textStyle` | composition | `theme.textStyles` |

### textStyle (composition)
`textStyle` applies font size, line height, and letter spacing together. Shipped scale referenced in docs: `xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl`. Custom named styles are defined via `defineTextStyles` and applied with `<Box textStyle="body">`.

### Verified token names (from examples)
- **fontWeight**: `semibold` (numeric values like `600` also accepted).
- **lineHeight**: `tall` (raw numeric like `1.5` also accepted).
- **letterSpacing**: `tight`, `wide`, `wider`, `widest`.
- **fontFamily**: `mono` (and default `body`/`heading` categories).

### Known gaps / Not published in llms.txt
- The numeric value tables for `fontSizes`, `fontWeights`, and `lineHeights` are rendered from component docs (`<SizesTokenDoc />`-style widgets) and are not included as literal values in the extracted llms text files. See https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/tokens for the live tables.
sections.layout:
### Layout
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-styling.txt

Layout uses style-prop primitives — **Box, Flex, Grid, SimpleGrid, Stack (HStack/VStack), Container, Center, Wrap, Group** — combined with the spacing (`space`), sizes, and breakpoint token scales. Responsive values use object syntax keyed by breakpoint (e.g. `fontSize={{ base: "16px", md: "18px" }}`).

### Spacing scale (`space`, real values)
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-theming.txt

| Token | Value | | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0.5` | `0.125rem` | | `8` | `2rem` |
| `1` | `0.25rem` | | `10` | `2.5rem` |
| `1.5` | `0.375rem` | | `12` | `3rem` |
| `2` | `0.5rem` | | `16` | `4rem` |
| `2.5` | `0.625rem` | | `20` | `5rem` |
| `3` | `0.75rem` | | `24` | `6rem` |
| `3.5` | `0.875rem` | | `32` | `8rem` |
| `4` | `1rem` | | `40` | `10rem` |
| `5` | `1.25rem` | | `48` | `12rem` |
| `6` | `1.5rem` | | `56` | `14rem` |

Scale continues through `7, 9, 11, 14, 28, 36, 44, 52` (0.25rem base grid).

### Breakpoints
| Token | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| `sm` | `<Box sm={{...}} />` |
| `md` | `<Box md={{...}} />` |
| `lg` | `<Box lg={{...}} />` |
| `xl` | `<Box xl={{...}} />` |
| `2xl` | `<Box 2xl={{...}} />` |

### Aspect ratios
| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `square` | `1 / 1` |
| `landscape` | `4 / 3` |
| `portrait` | `3 / 4` |
| `wide` | `16 / 9` |
| `ultrawide` | `18 / 5` |
| `golden` | `1.618 / 1` |

### Known gaps
- The `sizes` token table is rendered from a docs widget and not published as literal values in llms.txt.
sections.depth:
### Elevation & Depth
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-theming.txt

### Shadow tokens
Applied via the `shadow` style prop; semantic tokens adapt across color mode.
| Token | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `xs` | subtle raise |
| `sm` | low elevation |
| `md` | menus / cards |
| `lg` | popovers |
| `xl` | overlays |
| `2xl` | high elevation |
| `inner` | inset shadow |
| `inset` | inset variant |

### Z-index scale (real values)
| Token | Value | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hide` | `-1` | `overlay` | `1300` |
| `base` | `0` | `modal` | `1400` |
| `docked` | `10` | `popover` | `1500` |
| `dropdown` | `1000` | `skipNav` | `1600` |
| `sticky` | `1100` | `toast` | `1700` |
| `banner` | `1200` | `tooltip` | `1800` |
| | | `max` | `2147483647` |

### layerStyle
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-styling.txt

Reusable surface/elevation treatments are defined with `defineLayerStyles` and applied via the `layerStyle` prop (e.g. `<Box layerStyle="container">`). Chakra ships a set of built-in layer styles.

### Known gaps
- Literal box-shadow strings for each shadow token are rendered from a docs widget, not published as text in llms.txt.
sections.shapes:
### Shapes
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-theming.txt

Corner radius is a token scale applied via `borderRadius` / `rounded`.

### Radii tokens (real values)
| Token | rem | px |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | `0` | `0px` |
| `2xs` | `0.0625rem` | `1px` |
| `xs` | `0.125rem` | `2px` |
| `sm` | `0.25rem` | `4px` |
| `md` | `0.375rem` | `6px` |
| `lg` | `0.5rem` | `8px` |
| `xl` | `0.75rem` | `12px` |
| `2xl` | `1rem` | `16px` |
| `3xl` | `1.5rem` | `24px` |
| `4xl` | `2rem` | `32px` |
| `full` | `9999px` | `9999px` |

### Semantic radii
Component-level radii reference these aliases so global shape can be retuned in one place:
| Token | Maps to |
| --- | --- |
| `l1` | `{radii.xs}` |
| `l2` | `{radii.sm}` |
| `l3` | `{radii.md}` |

### Known gaps
- None for radii; the full scale is published with literal values.
sections.iconography:
### Iconography
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-components.txt

Chakra ships **no icon set**. The docs explicitly recommend bringing your own from popular libraries — **react-icons** or **lucide-react** (examples across the docs use `react-icons/lu`, i.e. Lucide).

### Rendering
- **`Icon`** component wraps any SVG/icon element and exposes token props like `size` (e.g. `size="lg"`) and `color`.
- **`asChild`** renders a custom inline `<svg>` through `Icon` so it inherits `currentColor` and token sizing.
- **`createIcon`** utility builds a reusable icon component from a `path`.
- **`IconButton`** is the dedicated icon-only button component.

### Governance
- No proprietary, versioned, or governed icon inventory — icon coverage and consistency are the consumer's responsibility.

### Known gaps
- No canonical icon naming, semantic tagging, or size ramp is published (it depends on the chosen third-party library).
sections.components:
### Components
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-components.txt

Broad v3 component set built on **Ark UI** state machines, styled with **recipes / slot recipes**. Variants, sizes, and states are encoded in the recipe (`variants`, `compoundVariants`, `defaultVariants`); `asChild` enables polymorphic rendering.

### Inventory (from llms-components.txt)
- **Layout / structure**: Box, Flex, Grid, SimpleGrid, Stack, Container, Center, AbsoluteCenter, AspectRatio, Bleed, Float, Group, Wrap, Separator, Splitter, Scroll Area, Float, Floating Panel
- **Typography**: Heading, Text, Code, Kbd, Em, Mark, Highlight, Blockquote, Prose, List
- **Forms & inputs**: Button, Icon Button, Input, Textarea, Number Input, Password Input, Pin Input, Checkbox, Checkbox Card, Radio, Radio Card, Switch, Select, Select (Native), Combobox, Listbox, Slider, Rating, Field, Fieldset, File Upload, Editable, Color Picker, Date Picker, Calendar, Segmented Control, Tags Input, Rich Text Editor
- **Navigation**: Breadcrumb, Tabs, Steps, Pagination, Link, Link Overlay, Menu, Skip Nav
- **Overlays**: Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Hover Card, Tooltip, Toggle Tip, Toast, Overlay Manager, Menu
- **Data display**: Table, DataList, Stat, Card, Badge, Tag, Avatar, Timeline, Accordion, Collapsible, TreeView, Status, QR Code, Code Block, Clipboard, Color Swatch
- **Feedback**: Alert, Progress, Progress Circle, Spinner, Skeleton, Empty State
- **Utilities**: Portal, Presence, Show, For, Client Only, Environment Provider, Locale Provider, Theme, Visually Hidden, Format Number, Format Byte, Marquee, Carousel, Action Bar, Close Button, Download Trigger, Checkmark, Radiomark

### Variant model
- `defineRecipe` — single-element components (`base`, `variants: { variant, size }`, `defaultVariants`).
- `defineSlotRecipe` — multi-part components (`slots`, per-slot `base`/`variants`).
- States are expressed with conditional styles / data attributes (`_hover`, `_active`, `_disabled`, `_focus`, ARIA/data-attribute selectors).

### Known gaps
- Per-component variant/size enumerations vary by component; consult each component page.
sections.dataviz:
### Data Visualization
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-charts.txt

Charts are a first-class, separately packaged feature: **`@chakra-ui/charts`**, built on top of **Recharts**, themed with Chakra tokens so charts inherit color mode and palette.

### Model
- Install: `npm i @chakra-ui/charts recharts`.
- Create a chart instance with the **`useChart`** hook (data + series), then wrap a Recharts chart in **`Chart.Root`**.
- Helpers: `chart.color("border.muted")` maps token names to CSS values; `chart.key(...)`, `chart.series`, `chart.data`.

### Chart types (real, from llms-charts.txt)
| Chart | Section |
| --- | --- |
| Area Chart | `# Area Chart` |
| Bar Chart | `# Bar Chart` |
| Line Chart | `# Line Chart` |
| Pie Chart | `# Pie Chart` |
| Donut Chart | `# Donut Chart` |
| Radar Chart | `# Radar Chart` |
| Scatter Chart | `# Scatter Chart` |

### Supporting parts
| Part | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Axis | axis configuration (`# Axis`) |
| Legend | series legend (`# Legend`) |
| Tooltip | hover tooltip (`# Tooltip`) |
| useChart | chart instance hook (`# useChart`) |

### Notes
- Because rendering is delegated to Recharts, additional Recharts primitives (e.g. `CartesianGrid`, `XAxis`, `YAxis`, `ReferenceLine`) compose inside `Chart.Root`.

### Known gaps
- No prescriptive chart color-accessibility or categorical-palette standard is published beyond token theming.
sections.content:
### Content: Voice & Tone
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/components/concepts/overview

**Not published.** Chakra UI is a component and styling system; it defines no product content, microcopy, voice, or tone standard. Copy shown in component examples is illustrative only.

### Not published
- Voice & tone principles
- Microcopy / UX writing guidelines
- Terminology or capitalization rules
sections.accessibility:
### Accessibility
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/components/concepts/overview

Interactive components are built on **Ark UI** headless state machines, which implement WAI-ARIA patterns — keyboard interaction, focus management, roles, and ARIA attributes are handled per component.

### Built-in a11y affordances (from docs)
- **Focus ring / focus-visible** — a built-in focus ring system with `focusRing` and `focusVisibleRing` utilities. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-styling.txt
- **Skip Nav** — `SkipNav` component for keyboard bypass links. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-components.txt
- **Visually Hidden** — `VisuallyHidden` for screen-reader-only content.
- **ARIA-attribute styling** — style props support ARIA selectors (e.g. `_expanded`, `aria-*`) and data-attribute state hooks.
- **Color mode** — light/dark with semantic tokens so contrast pairs adapt (`fg`/`bg` families).

### Known gaps / Not published in llms.txt
- There is no single consolidated accessibility standard doc in the extracted llms files; guarantees derive from Ark UI's per-component ARIA implementations. See https://ark-ui.com for the underlying patterns.
sections.dosdonts:
### Do's and Don'ts
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/semantic-tokens

### Do
- **Prefer semantic tokens** (`bg`, `fg`, `border`, `colorPalette.*`) over raw tokens — the docs recommend them because they auto-adapt to color mode. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms-theming.txt
- Provide full `50`–`950` scales for custom colors so `colorPalette` virtual colors work.
- Encode variants/sizes/states in **recipes / slot recipes** rather than ad-hoc conditionals. Source: https://chakra-ui.com/docs/theming/recipes
- Use `textStyle` / `layerStyle` for reusable, named compositions.
- Use responsive object syntax with the shipped breakpoint tokens.

### Don't
- Don't hardcode raw hex/px when a token exists (tokens compile to CSS variables and keep theming consistent).
- Don't expect a bundled icon set — bring your own (react-icons / lucide).

### Not published
- No shipped design linter or automated rule enforcement.
sections.agent:
### Agent Guidance
> Source: https://chakra-ui.com/llms.txt

Chakra publishes machine-readable docs and an MCP server for AI-assisted usage.

### LLM text files (split by concern)
| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `llms.txt` | index of doc sections |
| `llms-theming.txt` | tokens (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, z-index, breakpoints), semantic tokens, recipes |
| `llms-styling.txt` | style-props system, conditional/dark styles, text/layer/animation styles, focus ring |
| `llms-charts.txt` | `@chakra-ui/charts` (Recharts) chart types and API |
| `llms-components.txt` | full component inventory + usage examples |
| `llms-full.txt` | consolidated full corpus |

### MCP
- Chakra provides an **MCP server** so agents can pull component and theming context directly.

### Generation guidance
- Author UI with style props + semantic tokens; wire variants through recipes; theme charts via `chart.color(tokenName)`.

### Known gaps
- Exact MCP endpoint/versioning is documented on the Chakra site rather than in the llms text files.
